title: Plasma Diagnostics
description: A gas becomes a plasma when its charges screen each other: any stray charge is wrapped in a cloud of opposite charge a Debye length thick, and the gas behaves as one body only if many particles share each such cloud. The same few numbers describe the solar core, a fusion reactor, the ionosphere and the space between galaxies, where the Debye length runs from a hundredth of a nanometre to a hundred kilometres. A small wire dipped in, a Langmuir probe, reads them all. Unlocks the Langmuir Probe Station.

puzzle.goal: Poisson and Boltzmann together screen a charge over the Debye length. With permittivity ε₀, temperature kT, density n and charge q, write λ_D.
puzzle.name: Debye length
puzzle.form: sqrt ( ε * k * T / ( n * q ^ 2 ) )
puzzle.expr: sqrt ( e0 * k * T / ( n * q ^ 2 ) )
puzzle.ask: Find λ_D in metres for T = @{T} K and n = 10¹⁸ per cubic metre.
puzzle.method: Linearise the Boltzmann charge density, ρ ≈ −n·q²·φ/kT, into Poisson: ∇²φ = φ/λ_D².
